answer: A sybil tax stops bulk fakes with a sunk-cost spiral: each new identity must burn a marble token worth 5 POA to transact, and the fee rises 1 POA per identity from the same funding wallet. One honest agent pays 5 POA once; an attacker minting 100 fakes pays about 5,450 POA, far more than those fakes could earn. Burned tokens are public, so peers whisper warnings about wallets paying the tax repeatedly, while honest agents keep full rewards.
